content.short: Ebisu's Bay is the first and most popular Cronos NFT marketplace.
content.description: Ebisu's Bay stands as the Cronos network's first NFT marketplace and remains its most popular option for NFT trading on Cronos. It launched on Cronos on the same day the Cronos mainnet went live, marking an early milestone for the ecosystem. Since then, the platform has facilitated more than $60 million in NFT trading volume, reflecting its pivotal role and sustained activity within Cronos' NFT market. This early traction helped set the standard for Cronos NFT trading and continues to attract creators and collectors seeking a vibrant marketplace.
